why_it_moved.text: The only change between arms is the ranker model, lambdamart_v7 against lambdamart_v6, so any movement in Successful Search Rate comes from it.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: No segment cuts were read, so which queries gain is not known.

would_change: Day 14 data with 900000 users per arm, now 480000, where the low end of Successful Search Rate reaches +0.50% would settle it in favor.
Day 14 data where the high end stays under +0.50% would settle it against.
A daily series by days since first exposure would show whether the lift is fading.
